mapper.sql: sys04_role_id AS role_id, sys04_role_nm AS role_nm, sys04_seq AS seq, sys04_note AS note, sys04_company_id AS company_id, f_get_company_nm(sys04_company_id) AS company_nm, COALESCE(sys04_default_role = 'true', false) AS default_role, COALESCE(sys04_admin_yn = 'true', false) AS admin_yn
mapper.select: SELECT sys04_role_id AS role_id, sys04_role_nm AS role_nm, sys04_seq AS seq, sys04_note AS note, sys05_user_role_id IS NOT NULL AS user_role_yn, sys05_user_role_id AS user_role_id FROM sys04_role LEFT OUTER JOIN sys05_user_role ON sys04_role_id = sys05_role_id AND sys05_user_id = #{userId} WHERE 1=1 AND sys04_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY sys04_seq, sys05_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys04_role (sys04_role_id, sys04_role_nm, sys04_note, sys04_seq, sys04_company_id, sys04_default_role, sys04_admin_yn) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{roleNm}, #{note}, #{seq}, #{companyId}, 'false', 'false')
